_doc: Wording that went stale in THIS game, for instruction_lint.py. Copy to .claude/hooks/config/stale-patterns.json and start with an empty list. Add a pattern only when a decision really replaced the wording, and make it exact: a name, a path, a number. A broad pattern that fires on history gets the whole list ignored. Each pattern: id, regex, why; optional `and` (a second regex the line must match), `except_line` (a regex that clears the line), `except_paths` (file globs it skips). Never copy another game's list.
